title: GEG-SAM: Gaze Exploration-Guided Segment Anything Model for Weakly Supervised Polyp Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Endoscopist gaze offers an unobtrusively acquired record of lesion-oriented visual exploration during routine clinical inspection, providing relevant supervision for tasks. However, existing methods treat fixations as isolated spatial prompts directly associated with the target, overlooking the fact that natural gaze records a continuous visual search process in which fixations are temporally connected, spatially organized, and coupled with the visual content. Interpreting each fixation independently based only on its local visual content overlooks the temporal evolution and spatial organization of the gaze trajectory, whereas modeling relations among fixations alone cannot reveal the visual semantics of the regions they attend to. translated_title: GEG-SAM：面向弱监督息肉分割的注视探索引导的分割一切模型
translated_abstract: 内镜医生的注视提供了一种在常规临床检查中不引人注意地获得的、以病灶为导向的视觉探索记录，能够为相关任务提供监督信息。然而，现有方法将注视点视为与目标直接关联的孤立空间提示，忽视了自然注视记录的是一个连续的视觉搜索过程，其中注视点在时间上相互连接、在空间上组织有序，并与视觉内容相互耦合。仅基于局部视觉内容独立解释每个注视点会忽视注视轨迹的时间演变和空间组织，而仅对注视点之间的关系进行建模则无法揭示其所关注区域的视觉语义。为此，我们提出了注视探索引导的分割一切模型（GEG-SAM），这是一个具有原则性的弱监督框架，旨在显式利用结构化的注视关系及其相应的视觉内容。
tldr: 该论文提出GEG-SAM框架，通过显式建模内镜医生注视点的时空结构关系及其所关注区域的视觉语义，实现弱监督的息肉分割。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GEG-SAM, a weakly supervised framework for polyp segmentation that explicitly exploits structured spatiotemporal gaze relations and the visual semantics of the regions they attend to.
